    return rasp.numerical(rasp.Aggregate(prevs, bools, default=0)).named("frac_prevs")

    has_neg = rasp.numerical(rasp.Aggregate(select_all, any_negative, default=0)).named(
        "has_neg"

    # Check if all balances are 0 at the end -> closed all parentheses
    all_zero = balances[0] == 0
    for balance in balances[1:]:

    last_zero_all = rasp.Aggregate(select_all, last_zero, default=0).named("last_zero_all")

    not_has_neg = rasp.Map(lambda x: not x, has_neg).named("not_has_neg")

    # Both must be true everywhere
    result = last_zero_all & not_has_neg
    return result.named("shuffle_dyck")

        "any_negative"

    select_all = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.LEQ).named(
        "select_all"
    )
    has_neg = rasp.numerical(rasp.Aggregate(select_all, any_negative, default=0)).named(
        "has_neg"

    # Check if all balances are 0 at the end -> closed all parentheses
    all_zero = balances[0] == 0

    # Select only the last position

        "select_last"
    )
    last_zero = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, all_zero).named("last_zero")

    not_has_neg = (~has_neg).named("not_has_neg")
    # Combine last_zero and not_has_neg: this is only defined at the last position
    is_balanced_last = (last_zero & not_has_neg).named("is_balanced_last")

    # Now broadcast this value to all positions
    # Select all positions from the last position
    select_from_last = rasp.Select(length - 1, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.TRUE).named("select_from_last")
    # Aggregate is_balanced_last from the last position to all positions
    is_balanced = rasp.Aggregate(select_from_last, is_balanced_last, default=0).named("is_balanced")

    return is_balanced

- Compute `is_balanced_last` only at the last position.
